responsibility: Declares the generated pass-1 parser entry point. Its exported `CompilationUnit` routine runs the error-recovering second parse that populates early semantic structures such as modules, imports/exports, and procedure shells for use by later gm2 passes.
same_name_distinction: This file is only the exported interface for the generated pass-1 parser, exposing CompilationUnit; the same-stem .bnf file contains the actual grammar and parser actions that implement that pass.
